name: BRC Group Holdings (RILY)
teaser: Do not add. A $227 million loss on one stake left BRC Group's common holders a thin slice behind $1.32 billion of claims; at $3.64 the price assumes a recovery. Base $2.14, no buy zone.
llms: BRC Group Holdings (RILY), formerly B. Riley Financial, listed on NASDAQ, is a leveraged financial holding company with an investment bank, a wealth manager, legacy telecom businesses, Targus and a portfolio of stakes. Valued by sum of the parts with every senior claim and a normalized common earnings cross-check. In the third quarter of 2026 it lost $226.7 million on Babcock & Wilcox; common equity is a thin slice behind $1.32 billion of debt, preferred stock and minority interests, and $164 million of notes fall due on December 31, 2026. Bear $0.13, Base $2.14, Bull $10.13. Verdict Reduce at $3.64 (November 6, 2026 close), no buy zone. Updated from a September 24, 2026 Hold at $5.76.
